correctness.rationale: For T_m with hub c and m>=2 arms c-a_i-b_i-d_i, deleting c leaves the exact join of m triangular boundaries K=(∂Δ²)^{*m}. The link L(c) is Δ({b_i,d_i}) together with a_i*Δ(B\{b_i}); the S_m-equivariant simplicial retraction a_i↦d_i has a contiguous identity homotopy and a fixed barycentric contraction, so L^H is contractible for every H. Equivariant homotopy pushout of K←L→c*L identifies |X_m|^H with |K|^H. The permutation representation on m real 2-planes has fixed dimension 2o(H), hence sphere S^{2o(H)-1}; even-dimensional block swaps preserve orientation. Reconstructed all quantifiers, fixed geometric realization not fixed-vertex subcomplex, m=2 and transitive cases. Independent program directly expanded arm orbit faces, checked induced-component sizes, and computed mod-two homology for seven orbit patterns; finite tests are corroboration only.
